scene:
Three zones read left to right.

LEFT ZONE: an investor figure in a suit holding a large speech bubble labelled AI STRATEGY?. From the bubble, three thick navy arrows fan out to the right, one to each of three horizontal lanes stacked top, middle and bottom in the middle zone.

MIDDLE ZONE, three horizontal lanes separated by thin lines, each read left to right as: icon, question label, test card, result.
TOP LANE: a shopping cart icon with the label WILL CUSTOMERS PAY?; then a card showing a stack of documents being sorted into trays, labelled PAID TRIAL €45K; then an arrow to an envelope with a form, labelled FUNDING REQUEST, NOT LAUNCH.
MIDDLE LANE: a headset icon for support work with the label WILL INTERNAL WORK IMPROVE?; then an hourglass pouring into a box, labelled SAVED TIME = CAPACITY; then an arrow to an empty office chair with a calendar moved forward, labelled HIRE DEFERRED: €24K CASH.
BOTTOM LANE: a chess piece being pushed off the board by a generic chat bubble robot, with the label COULD WE BE REPLACED?; then a card with five small customer figures around a blank grid sheet with no heading or words on it, labelled SUBSTITUTE TEST €15K; then an arrow to a signpost with four blank arms, with one label under the signpost: DEFEND / REPRICE / PARTNER / STOP.

RIGHT ZONE: all three lanes' final arrows converge on one large ochre-outlined panel showing a hand passing a coin across a table with a small calendar beside it, labelled SAVING IS REAL ONLY WHEN A PAYMENT CHANGES.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: AI STRATEGY?, WILL CUSTOMERS PAY?, PAID TRIAL €45K, FUNDING REQUEST, NOT LAUNCH, WILL INTERNAL WORK IMPROVE?, SAVED TIME = CAPACITY, HIRE DEFERRED: €24K CASH, COULD WE BE REPLACED?, SUBSTITUTE TEST €15K, DEFEND / REPRICE / PARTNER / STOP, SAVING IS REAL ONLY WHEN A PAYMENT CHANGES. The signpost arms, documents, schedule sheet, calendar and cards carry no writing. Any other text is a defect.
alt: An investor's request for an AI strategy splits into three lanes: will customers pay, tested by a €45,000 paid trial whose success earns a funding request rather than a launch; will internal work improve, where saved time is capacity and a deferred hire yields about €24,000 of cash; and could the company be replaced, tested for €15,000 before choosing to defend, reprice, partner or stop. All three lead to one rule: a saving is real only when a payment changes.
caption: One request, three questions, each with its own test, and the rule that decides what counts as a saving.
